title.narrative: Improving access to healthcare in northern Uganda

description.narrative: This activity Improving access to healthcare in northern Uganda is a component of Post-Conflict Development in Northern Uganda reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £12,170,824. It works in the following sector(s): Reproductive health care, Basic health care, Health policy and administrative management.
